task_description: Fix the verified P0 behavioural defects from the template gap analysis: checkpoint migration, hybrid-storage sync ordering and ID handling, actor Init validation, and the release.toml replacements
issues: #5 checkpoint migration never ran and its API could not be implemented
#1 hybrid-storage sync hook fired before the page commit
#2 trim_start_matches truncated record ids that begin with the prefix
#3 get_record never verified the payload id it promised to check
#7 actor stored Init state before validating it
#12 release.toml replacements aborted the first release

resolution.checkpoint_migration: Storable::migrate now takes the raw bincode bytes instead of serde_json::Value, because bincode is not self-describing and cannot decode into Value (verified: AnyNotSupported). Added Storable::supports_migration_from as an explicit opt-in; load() runs the migration chain and otherwise fails closed with VersionMismatch. MigrationRegistry gained path() and migrate_with() so a registered chain actually applies each step.
resolution.sync_hook_ordering: on_page_synced now fires after apply_transaction, matching its documented contract; it previously reported pages a failed commit could still discard.
resolution.record_id_prefix: strip_prefix replaces trim_start_matches, which stripped the prefix repeatedly and turned an id like rec:x into x.
resolution.get_record_id_check: get_record now returns CorruptRecord when the decoded payload id differs from the requested id, as its doc comment already claimed.
resolution.actor_init_validation: Init validates the incoming state before assigning it, so a rejected transition leaves the previous state intact.
resolution.release_toml: Removed the lowercase `unreleased` replacement, which matched zero times in a changelog containing only `## [Unreleased]` and therefore aborted the release under min = 1; anchored the VERSION regex so it cannot match inside a link or prose.

root_cause: The defects were unimplemented or misordered code paths whose README and doc comments described behaviour that never existed. The published checkpoint-template README advertised automatic migration that a real consumer could not use.
verification: Every fix has a regression test that was proven non-vacuous by reverting the fix and watching the test fail
Consumer-style crates.io probe that previously printed `FAILED: Version mismatch` now prints `LOADED (migration ran)`
bincode into serde_json::Value confirmed impossible with a standalone AnyNotSupported probe before changing the public API
trim_start_matches over-matching demonstrated on rec:rec:x before switching to strip_prefix
release.toml: the removed lowercase pattern matched 0 lines in CHANGELOG.md; the new VERSION anchor matches exactly 1
./scripts/quality-gates.sh: all checks pass, Overall Status SUCCESS
cargo machete confirmed serde_json became genuinely unused rather than suppressing the warning
notes: Four of the twelve P0 items remain unfixed and were not in the approved scope: watermark enforcement, supervisor restarts, the MCP JSON-RPC/stdio protocol, and the egress/path/redaction validators. Two files were split to respect the 500-LOC limit: hybrid-storage-template/src/sync.rs and checkpoint-template/src/tests_migration.rs. The migrate signature change is a breaking change to a published crate and needs a minor version bump.
